paras: 03 Days Delhi, Agra & Jaipur Tour Package
Tour Code #DR074
Rs.6999/- per person
Day : 01 – Arrival in Delhi
Welcome to Delhi! Our representative will give you a warm welcome at Delhi Airport or railway station. We will start our journey by exploring the stunning attractions of Delhi:
Red Fort: A sign of Mughal splendor.
Purana Quilas: Antique fort, representing past glories.
Jama Masjid: Big Mosque of everlasting reverence.
Qutab Minar: Momentous tower, reaching the sky.
India Gate: Compliment to fallen heroes' courage.
Chandni Chowk: Busy market, rich with culture.
Lakshmi Narayan Temple: Heavenly peace in modern sanctuary.
Later we will move to Agra. Upon the time of arrival, we will check in at hotel. Enjoy the comfortable stay at Agra hotel.
Day: 02 – Agra - Jaipur
After having a delicious breakfast, we will visit most iconic sites of Agra:
Taj Mahal - The symbol of love
Agra Fort – Unique and attractive creation
Itimad-Ud-Daulah– A Historic Place of Worship
Local Markets & Bazaars – Best for spending time and do shopping
In the afternoon, we will head to Jaipur (Pink City). Check in at your hotel upon arrival and enjoy a restful night in Jaipur.
Day 3: Sightseeing in Jaipur & Departure
Start your day with a hearty breakfast before we set off to discover the historic pink city of Jaipur:
Hawa Mahal - The famous "Palace of Winds."
City Palace - A fabulous mixture of Rajasthani and Mughal culture.
Observatory / Jantar Mantar - A remarkable collection of planetary instruments.
Jal Mahal - The beautiful "Water Palace."
Amer Fort - A majestic fort with stunning views.
Nahargarh Fort - Offering beautiful panoramic views of the city.
After a day full of sightseeing, we will drop you off at the Jaipur railway station or airport for your departure.End of Tour – Safe Travels!
